name: dev-team
description: Builds features with TDD: a light mode (default) where the session plans and implements itself, and a full mode that runs specialist database/frontend/backend/devops engineers in parallel for well-specified multi-discipline work. User-approved plans, a shared context brief so agents don't re-explore the codebase, one reviewer that verifies and reviews each phase, phased delivery for large requests, and resumable paused runs.
